card.name: Digits inside confidence interval limits
card.fires_on: Numbers or decimal points inside the upper limit of a confidence interval after a hazard ratio, such as the point or digit after '2' in '1.22, 2.19'. Also a year digit in '2011'.

modes.label: Upper CI limit digits
modes.description: A digit or decimal point partway through the second number of a 95% CI after an HR.

modes.label: Decimal point in CI
modes.description: The decimal point after the whole-number part of the upper limit.
